notes.title: v1.3.1 - world map reliability and performance imporvements
notes.content:
Improved overall reliability of world map (fixed various synchronization bugs)
 Notably improved world map performance (especially world and log loading)
 Fixed mission start countdown timer

notes.title: v1.3.0 - new assault experience and more!
notes.content:
In the 1.3.0 update:


 Changed assault game mode difficulty scaling, units economy and spawn, feels much better now!
 Added allies to resource collection missions
 Improved level design and enemy conquering strategy
 Artillery and grenades now work fine during multiplayer game
 Fixed numerous other networking issues, visual glitches and performance artifacts

notes.title: v1.2.1 - improved mission economy
notes.content:
In the 1.2.1 update:


 New mission reward resources calculation system, more pain more gain
 New engine version, better performance and other things work better (probably)

notes.title: v1.2.0 - new game mode and more!
notes.content:
In the 1.2.0 update:


 Assault missions - assist allied forces in offensive, conquer points to stop enemy reinforcement and get more allied firepower
 Reworked networking model, which means better connection between server and client
 Fixed various AI issues and visual bugs
 Weapons rebalanced
